parsed.text: Summary: Panel p0 current estimates (copied from record_time 11, represented_time 12 for most nodes; n3 from history_estimate) show nodes n0–n2 uniformly distributed for both red and blue (all 16 cells equal). p0 current n3 concentrates blue at cell [1,0] (peak probability ~0.903) and red at [1,2] (~0.311). For p0 conditional candidates (k0,k1,k2) node n2 shifts to blue peaks at [0,2] and red peaks at [0,1]; k0 is most extreme for blue (peak ~0.979) and k2 gives very high red peak (~0.909). Panel p1 current (completed_record, represented_time 12) is uniform at most nodes. p1 conditional records vary at n2: k0 splits blue peaks over four cells ([0,2],[0,3],[1,2],[1,3]) and red over four cells ([0,0],[0,1],[1,0],[1,1]); k1 concentrates blue at [0,2] and red at [0,1]; k2 and many current entries are uniform. Copied prior records are not new estimates; conditional command records are conditional forecasts, not events that have already occurred.
